title: Super-resolution imaging of synaptic scaffold proteins in rat hippocampal neurons
protocol: Prepare working solutions of 10 mM Artemisinin, Artemether, and Artesunate on the day of experiments.
Treat primary hippocampal cultures with 50 μM of Artemether for 1 h by directly adding it to growth media.
Treat primary hippocampal cultures with 50 μM of Artemisinin for 1 h by directly adding it to growth media.
Treat primary hippocampal cultures with 50 μM of Artesunate for 1 h by directly adding it to growth media.
Treat control samples with an equivalent volume of DMSO.
Remove growth media from cell culture MatTek dishes.
Replace removed media immediately with 4% PFA solution for 20 min at room temperature (RT).
Wash cells 3 × 5 min with PBS 1× after fixation.
Remove PBS and permeabilize with 0.2% Triton X-100 for 30 min at RT.
Wash cells 3 × 5 min with PBS 1× following permeabilization.
Block with 1% BSA and 2% normal goat serum diluted in PBS for 2 h at RT.
Prepare primary antibodies in blocking buffer.
Prepare 120 μL of antibody solution per coverslip.
Stain inhibitory presynaptic marker vGAT at a dilution of 1:500.
Stain inhibitory postsynaptic scaffold protein gephyrin at a dilution of 1:150.
Stain dendritic marker MAP2 at a dilution of 1:1000.
Incubate cells in primary antibody diluted in blocking buffer overnight (15–20 h) at 4°C.
Place dishes into a humid chamber for incubation to prevent evaporation of the primary antibody solution.
Wash cells 3 times with PBS for 5 minutes each.
Prepare secondary antibodies in blocking buffer.
Dilute AF647 antibody at a ratio of 1:350.
Dilute AF568 antibody at a ratio of 1:1000.
Dilute AF488 antibody at a ratio of 1:500.
Mix 120 μL of the appropriate antibody solution per coverslip.
Use AF647 for tagging gephyrin.
Use AF568 for tagging vGAT.
Incubate cells in secondary antibody diluted in blocking buffer for 90 min at room temperature.
Place dishes back into the humid chamber for incubation to ensure the secondary antibody does not evaporate.
Cover the humid chamber with foil to prevent photobleaching of the secondary antibodies.
Incubate cells in 4% PFA buffer for 20 min at room temperature for post-staining fixation.
Store samples in storage buffer in a dark environment at 4°C.
Calibrate optical system focal planes and color channels for accurate single molecule localization (SML).
Determine point spread function (PSF) of a point source for 3D measured point spread functions.
Prepare 100 nm Tetraspeck bead samples emitting at blue, green, orange, and red on poly-d-lysine coated MatTek dishes.
Use 60× objective (1.3 NA, silicone oil) for dSTORM imaging.
Apply one drop of silicone immersion oil to the center of 60× objective without air bubbles.
Replace storage solution with imaging buffer (∼200 μL to cover coverslip).
Find region of interest using 488 channel (exciting fluorophores tagged to MAP2) at low laser power.
Conduct search on a low laser power to prevent photo-switching and photobleaching.
Perform sequential imaging of the 640 channel.
Begin image acquisition with constant illumination from a 640 nm laser at 463.4 mW.
Gradually increase the 405 nm laser power from 1 to 10% of maximum power (from 1 to 49.7 mW) over the imaging period.
Take 20,000 frames of the 647 channel.
Illuminate the 555 nm laser at constant 555 mW for 10,000 frames.
Image 3 regions of interest per coverslip.
Take single z-plane images with a z-distance of 2 μm due to biplane illumination.
Set exposure time to 20 ms and capture images at 50 frames per second.
Use widefield field of view of 200 μm × 200 μm for imaging.
Use super resolution field of view of 50 μm × 50 μm for high-resolution imaging.
Ensure robust photo-switching of the fluorophore, appearing as blinking upon excitation.
Optimize antibody concentrations and buffer conditions to achieve adequate blinking.
Adjust laser power settings to reach a steady state level of photo-switching.
Use silicone oil to decrease spherical aberration during imaging.
Identify individual molecules by their brightness above the background in a frame-by-frame process.
Generate a molecule’s coordinates in space by fitting the imaged PSF with the 3D measured PSF.
Filter images using SRX software to conduct single molecule localizations.
Define particles from the filtered images.
Localize fluorophores within defined particles.
Conduct Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBScan) to define clusters of SMLs of the same probe based on proximity.
Use parameters appropriate for defining arbitrarily shaped clusters from a spatial database.
Apply DBScan algorithm to group single molecule localizations into synaptic clusters.
Cluster single molecule localizations according to the DBScan algorithm.
Eliminate molecules not localized to any cluster from further analysis.
Determine cluster α shapes.
Analyze gephyrin volume based on cluster data.
Calculate vGAT-gephyrin centroid distance for analysis.
Evaluate density of clusters for further investigation.
Investigate the spatial organization of vGAT and gephyrin clusters using stochastic optical reconstruction microscopy-based relative localization analysis (Storm-RLA).
Use Storm—RLA algorithm cluster α shapes generated in step 21 to define pre- and post-synaptic pairs based on their position in space.
Eliminate non-paired clusters from the analysis.
Calculate vGAT and gephyrin cluster centroid distance, with a max cluster distance of 1 μm.
Conduct cluster density analysis to understand the spatial distribution of gephyrin molecules.
Assess individual gephyrin clusters in 2D by condensing localizations to the X-Y plane.
For each individual cluster, determine a theoretical pair correlation function (PCF).
Account for the density and shape of the cluster to generate a theoretical fit as if the molecules were randomly organized.
Normalize individual PCFs of each individual cluster to their theoretical fit to account for shape, volume, and density.
Set search radius from center at 500 nm with 100 bins.
Calculate the probability function g(r) indicating how likely you are to find another molecule within a given distance.
